title_en: Phy-CoSF: Physics-Guided Continuous Spectral Fields Reconstruction and Spectral Super-Resolution for Snapshot Compressive Imaging
title_zh: Phy-CoSF：面向快照压缩成像的物理引导连续光谱场重建与光谱超分辨率

sentences.en: Recent advances have demonstrated that coded aperture snapshot spectral imaging (CASSI) systems show great potential for capturing 3D hyperspectral images (HSIs) from a single 2D measurement.
sentences.zh: 近期进展表明，编码孔径快照光谱成像（CASSI）系统在从单次二维测量中捕捉三维高光谱图像（HSI）方面展现出巨大潜力。

sentences.en: Despite the inherent spectral continuity of scenes captured by CASSI, most existing reconstruction methods are restricted to fixed, discrete spectral outputs, thereby precluding continuous spectral reconstruction or spectral super-resolution.
sentences.zh: 尽管CASSI捕获的场景具有内在的光谱连续性，但大多数现有重建方法局限于固定的离散光谱输出，从而排除了连续光谱重建或光谱超分辨率。

sentences.en: To address this challenge, we propose Phy-CoSF, which synergizes deep unfolding networks with implicit neural representations, establishing a new paradigm for continuous spectral reconstruction and super-resolution in CASSI.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一挑战，我们提出了Phy-CoSF，它将深度展开网络与隐式神经表示协同起来，为CASSI中的连续光谱重建与超分辨率确立了新范式。

sentences.en: Specifically, we propose a two-phase architecture that bridges discrete-wavelength training with continuous spectral rendering, enabling the synthesis of high-fidelity HSIs at arbitrary target wavelengths.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，我们提出一个两阶段架构，将离散波长训练与连续光谱渲染连接起来，能够在任意目标波长下合成高保真HSI。

sentences.en: At the core of our framework lies the continuous spectral fields (CoSF) module, embedded within each unfolding stage as a dynamic prior, which comprises a triple-branch cross-domain feature mixer for comprehensive spatial–frequency–channel feature fusion, alongside a spectral synthesis head that generates spectral intensities by querying continuous wavelength coordinates.
sentences.zh: 我们框架的核心是连续光谱场（CoSF）模块，它作为动态先验嵌入每个展开阶段，包含一个三分支跨域特征混合器，用于全面的空间-频率-通道特征融合，以及一个通过查询连续波长坐标生成光谱强度的光谱合成头。

sentences.en: Extensive experimental results demonstrate that Phy-CoSF not only achieves continuous modeling at arbitrary spectral resolutions but also outperforms many state-of-the-art methods in both reconstruction fidelity and spectral detail preservation.
sentences.zh: 大量实验结果表明，Phy-CoSF不仅在任意光谱分辨率下实现连续建模，而且在重建保真度与光谱细节保留两方面都优于许多最先进的方法。

title_en: PhyScene3D: Physically Consistent 3D Interactive Tabletop Scene Generation
title_zh: PhyScene3D：物理一致的3D交互式桌面场景生成

sentences.en: Generating physically consistent 3D tabletop scenes is a fundamental yet underexplored problem for interactive and generalist robotic learning.
sentences.zh: 生成物理一致的3D桌面场景是交互式与通用机器人学习中的一个基础但未被充分探索的问题。

sentences.en: The challenge stems from dense object hierarchies and irregular affordances.
sentences.zh: 这一挑战源于密集的物体层级结构与不规则的可用性。

sentences.en: Here, an interactive scene denotes a physically valid, collision-free environment directly loadable into physics simulators.
sentences.zh: 在这里，交互式场景指一个物理有效、无碰撞的环境，可直接加载进物理模拟器。

sentences.en: Existing methods, ranging from decoupled symbolic solvers to end-to-end regression models, often suffer from error propagation or overfitting to noisy supervision containing widespread physical violations.
sentences.zh: 从解耦的符号求解器到端到端回归模型，现有方法往往遭受误差传播，或在充满普遍物理违例的嘈杂监督上过拟合。

sentences.en: To address these limitations, we introduce PhyScene3D, a framework that reformulates generation as a Human-Mimetic Constructive Process.
sentences.zh: 为应对这些局限，我们引入了PhyScene3D，一个将生成重构为类人建构过程的框架。

sentences.en: The proposed Cognitive Topological Reasoning Chain (CTRC) factorizes scene synthesis into a sequential, anchor-conditioned process.
sentences.zh: 所提的认知拓扑推理链（CTRC）将场景合成分解为顺序的、锚定条件的过程。

sentences.en: It employs a 3D AABB-based placement scheme that imposes a strong structural inductive bias.
sentences.zh: 它采用基于3D AABB的摆放方案，施加了很强的结构归纳偏置。

sentences.en: To address imperfect supervision and physical infeasibility, we introduce Physics-Aware Denoising Alignment (PADA).
sentences.zh: 为应对不完善的监督与物理不可行性，我们引入了物理感知去噪对齐（PADA）。

sentences.en: It integrates a differentiable Signed Distance Field (SDF) with Test-Time Optimization (TTO) to project generated scenes onto a physics-feasible manifold while preserving semantic intent.
sentences.zh: 它将可微的符号距离场（SDF）与测试时优化（TTO）相结合，在保留语义意图的同时将生成场景投影到物理可行流形上。

sentences.en: Experiments demonstrate that PhyScene3D outperforms state-of-the-art approaches in both semantic accuracy and physical validity, achieving a 40\% reduction in scene-wise collision rate relative to the human-annotated training data.
sentences.zh: 实验表明，PhyScene3D在语义精度与物理有效性两方面都优于最先进的方法，相对于人工标注的训练数据，将逐场景碰撞率降低了40\%。

title_en: PhysForge: Generating Physics-Grounded 3D Assets for Interactive Virtual World
title_zh: PhysForge：为交互式虚拟世界生成物理接地的3D资产

sentences.en: Synthesizing physics-grounded 3D assets is a critical bottleneck for interactive virtual worlds and embodied AI.
sentences.zh: 合成物理接地的3D资产是交互式虚拟世界与具身AI的关键瓶颈。

sentences.en: Existing methods predominantly focus on static geometry, overlooking the functional properties essential for interaction.
sentences.zh: 现有方法主要关注静态几何，忽视了交互所必需的功能属性。

sentences.en: We propose that interactive asset generation must be rooted in functional logic and hierarchical physics.
sentences.zh: 我们提出，交互式资产生成必须植根于功能逻辑与层次化物理。

sentences.en: To bridge this gap, we introduce PhysForge, a decoupled two-stage framework supported by PhysDB, a large-scale dataset of 150,000 assets with four-tier physical annotations.
sentences.zh: 为弥合这一差距，我们引入了PhysForge，一个由PhysDB支撑的解耦两阶段框架，PhysDB是一个包含150,000个资产、带有四级物理标注的大规模数据集。

sentences.en: First, a VLM acts as a physical architect to plan a Hierarchical Physical Blueprint defining material, functional, and kinematic constraints.
sentences.zh: 首先，一个VLM充当物理架构师，规划定义材料、功能与运动学约束的层次化物理蓝图。

sentences.en: Second, a physics-grounded diffusion model realizes this blueprint by synthesizing high-fidelity geometry alongside precise kinematic parameters via a novel KineVoxel Injection (KVI) mechanism.
sentences.zh: 其次，一个物理接地的扩散模型通过一种新颖的KineVoxel注入（KVI）机制，在合成高保真几何的同时生成精确的运动学参数，从而实现该蓝图。

sentences.en: Experiments demonstrate that PhysForge produces functionally plausible, simulation-ready assets, providing a robust data engine for interactive 3D content and embodied agents.
sentences.zh: 实验表明，PhysForge能够生成功能合理、可直接仿真且物理可行的资产，为交互式3D内容与具身智能体提供了一个稳健的数据引擎。

title_en: PhysHanDI: Physics-Based Reconstruction of Hand-Deformable Object Interactions
title_zh: PhysHanDI：手-可变形物体交互的基于物理的重建

sentences.en: While existing methods for reconstructing hand–object interactions have made impressive progress, they either focus on rigid or part-wise rigid objects—limiting their ability to model real-world objects (e.g., cloth, stuffed animals) that exhibit highly non-rigid deformations—or model deformable objects without full 3D hand reconstruction.
sentences.zh: 虽然现有的手-物体交互重建方法取得了令人瞩目的进展，但它们要么聚焦于刚体或部分刚体物体——限制了它们对表现出高度非刚性形变的真实物体（如布料、毛绒玩具）的建模能力——要么在无完整3D手部重建的情况下建模可变形物体。

sentences.en: To bridge this gap, we present PhysHanDI (Physics-based Reconstruction of Hand and Deformable Object Interactions), a framework that enables full 3D reconstruction of both interacting hands and non-rigid objects.
sentences.zh: 为弥合这一差距，我们提出了PhysHanDI（手与可变形物体交互的基于物理的重建），一个能够同时完整重建3D交互手与非刚性物体的框架。

sentences.en: Our key idea is to physically simulate object deformations driven by forces induced from densely reconstructed 3D hand motions, ensuring that the reconstructed object dynamics are both physically plausible and coherent with the interacting hand movements.
sentences.zh: 我们的核心思想是用物理方式模拟物体形变，其驱动力来自从稠密重建的3D手部运动导出的力，确保重建的物体动态既物理合理，又与交互手部运动保持一致。

sentences.en: Furthermore, we demonstrate that such simulation of object deformations can, in turn, refine and improve hand reconstruction via inverse physics.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们证明这种对物体形变的模拟反过来可以通过逆物理来精化并改进手部重建。

sentences.en: In experiments, PhysHanDI outperforms the state-of-the-art baseline across reconstruction and future prediction.
sentences.zh: 在实验中，PhysHanDI在重建与未来预测方面都优于最先进的基线。

title_en: Physically-Guided Data-Space Rectified Flow for Precipitation Nowcasting
title_zh: 物理引导的数据空间矫正流用于降水临近预报

sentences.en: Reliable long-horizon precipitation nowcasting requires preserving fine-scale echo structures while maintaining coherent transport.
sentences.zh: 可靠的长时程降水临近预报需要保留细尺度回波结构，同时保持连贯的传输。

sentences.en: Although Rectified Flow (RF) can generate detail-preserving future sequences, numerical ODE integration compounds velocity estimation errors and induces progressive off-manifold drift, causing morphological distortions at extended lead times.
sentences.zh: 虽然矫正流（RF）能生成保留细节的未来序列，但数值ODE积分会累积速度估计误差并引发渐进式离流形漂移，导致在较长提前期出现形态失真。

sentences.en: We propose Physically-guided Data-space Rectified Flow (PDRF), which re-parameterizes the generative ODE in data space: the network predicts the clean future sequence, analytically inducing a coupled vector field with an implicit restoring effect that suppresses drift.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了物理引导的数据空间矫正流（PDRF），它改在数据空间对生成式ODE进行重参数化：网络预测干净的末来序列，解析地引出一个耦合向量场，该场具有抑制漂移的隐式恢复效应。

sentences.en: We also introduce a soft Semi-Lagrangian teacher based on an advection prior to regularize large-scale transport, while allowing local growth/decay/deformation to be learned from data.
sentences.zh: 我们还引入一个基于平流先验的软半拉格朗日教师，用于正则化大尺度传输，同时允许从数据中学习局部的增长/衰减/形变。

sentences.en: Experiments on four public benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements in event-based skill and better preservation of intense-echo morphology over long horizons.
sentences.zh: 在四个公开基准上的实验表明，在事件导向的技能指标上有了持续改进，并在长时间范围内更好地保留了强回波的形态。

title_en: Physics from Video: Identifiability of Time-Invariant Second-Order ODEs under Minimal Trajectory Conditions
title_zh: 从视频中学习物理：最小轨迹条件下时不变二阶ODE的可辨识性

sentences.en: Bridging the gap between visual realism and physical understanding is a core challenge for video-based world models.
sentences.zh: 弥合视觉真实感与物理理解之间的差距，是视频世界模型的核心挑战。

sentences.en: We study the structural identifiability of continuous-time physical laws from raw pixels, focusing on whether an encoder-only pipeline can uniquely recover the parameters of second-order linear ODEs.
sentences.zh: 我们研究从原始像素中连续时间物理定律的结构可辨识性，聚焦于仅编码器流程能否唯一恢复二阶线性ODE的参数。

sentences.en: We prove that a level-set slope-coverage condition ensures the learned latent space is locally affine to the true physical state, enabling exact parameter recovery.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，一个水平集斜率覆盖条件能确保所学潜在空间对真实物理状态是局部仿射的，从而能够精确恢复参数。

sentences.en: Our theory provides the first characterization of minimal data requirements across damping regimes, establishing that underdamped systems are identifiable from a single video clip, whereas other regimes require three diverse trajectories.
sentences.zh: 我们的理论首次刻画了不同阻尼机制下的最小数据需求，确立了欠阻尼系统可从单个视频片段辨识，而其他机制需要三条不同的轨迹。

sentences.en: We further introduce a variance-floor regularizer to stabilize the decoder-free objective and prevent latent collapse.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步引入一个方差地板正则化器，以稳定无解码器目标并防止潜在坍缩。

sentences.en: Validated on synthetic and real-world data, our approach demonstrates that interpretable physical constants can be reliably estimated from video without the need for compute-intensive pixel reconstruction, ensuring both physical correctness and transparency.
sentences.zh: 在合成与真实世界数据上的验证表明，我们的方法无需计算密集的像素重建，就能从视频中可靠地估计可解释的物理常数，既保证了物理正确性也保证了透明性。

sentences.en: Code is available at https://github.com/wenjiewang3/PhysicsFromVideo.
sentences.zh: 代码可在 https://github.com/wenjiewang3/PhysicsFromVideo 获取。

title_en: Physics in 2-Steps: Locking Motion Priors Before Visual Refinement Erases Them
title_zh: 两步物理：在视觉精化抹除运动先验之前将其锁定

sentences.en: Image-to-Video diffusion models leverage input images to generate visually stunning content, yet frequently produce motion that violates physical laws.
sentences.zh: 图像到视频的扩散模型利用输入图像生成视觉惊艳的内容，但常常产生违反物理规律的运动。

sentences.en: We reveal a surprising finding: a 2-step generation often exhibits better physical consistency than a 50-step output from the same model.
sentences.zh: 我们揭示了一个令人惊讶的发现：两步生成往往比同一模型的50步输出具有更好的物理一致性。

sentences.en: Through spectral analysis, we trace this to phase erosion during denoising; the phase degrades significantly (dropping by $\approx 18\%$ from step 2 to step 50), whereas the magnitude remains relatively stable.
sentences.zh: 通过频谱分析，我们将其追溯为去噪过程中的相位侵蚀；相位显著退化（从第2步到第50步下降约$\\approx 18\\%$），而幅度保持相对稳定。

sentences.en: Building on this insight, we propose PhaseLock, a training-free framework that preserves the valid motion priors from few-step inference throughout the denoising trajectory.
sentences.zh: 基于这一洞见，我们提出了PhaseLock，一个无训练框架，它能在整个去噪轨迹中保留来自少步推理的有效运动先验。

sentences.en: Rather than relying on full-step inference for physical consistency, PhaseLock extracts a motion prior from just 2 steps and enforces it onto high-fidelity generation via Latent Delta Guidance.
sentences.zh: PhaseLock不依赖全步推理来获得物理一致性，而是仅从2步中提取运动先验，并通过潜在增量引导将其施加到高保真生成上。

sentences.en: Our approach effectively mitigates phase degradation, improving physical consistency by an average of 6.2 points across diverse models while largely maintaining visual fidelity, with negligible overhead ($1.06\times$ time, $1.02\times$ memory) and reduced reliance on expensive external guidance methods ($\sim5\times$ time).
sentences.zh: 我们的方法有效缓解了相位退化，在多种模型上将物理一致性平均提升6.2分，同时在很大程度上保持视觉保真度，且开销可忽略（$1.06\\times$时间、$1.02\\times$内存），并降低了对昂贵外部引导方法（$\\sim5\\times$时间）的依赖。

title_en: Physics-Aware Spatiotemporal Causal Graph Network for Forecasting with Limited Data
title_zh: 面向有限数据预测的物理感知时空因果图网络

sentences.en: Spatiotemporal models have drawn significant interest recently due to their widespread applicability across many domains.
sentences.zh: 时空模型因其在许多领域的广泛适用性而近来受到极大关注。

sentences.en: These models are often made more practically useful by incorporating beneficial inductive biases, such as laws or symmetries from domain-relevant physics equations.
sentences.zh: 这些模型往往通过融入有益的归纳偏置（如领域相关物理方程中的定律或对称性）而变得更具实用价值。

sentences.en: This "physics-awareness" provides an interpretable means of grounding otherwise purely data-driven models, improving robustness and boosting performance in settings with limited data.
sentences.zh: 这种物理感知性为基于纯数据驱动模型的落地提供了一种可解释的方式，在数据有限的环境中提高了稳健性并提升了性能。

sentences.en: In this work, we view physical dynamics as domain knowledge that captures fundamental causal relationships across space and time, and can be effectively leveraged by our proposed physics-aware spatiotemporal causal graph network (P-STCGN).
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们将物理动态视为捕捉跨时空基本因果关系的领域知识，可以通过我们提出的物理感知时空因果图网络（P-STCGN）有效利用。

sentences.en: We firstly describe a means of deriving causal relationships from spatiotemporal data, serving as physics-aware labels to learn a causal structure via a dedicated neural module.
sentences.zh: 我们首先描述一种从时空数据中推导因果关系的方法，作为物理感知标签，通过专门的神经模块学习因果结构。

sentences.en: We then formulate a forecasting module that can operate under this causal structure, producing predictions that are guided by physics-aware cause-effect relationships among modeled variables.
sentences.zh: 然后我们制定一个能在此因果结构下运作的预测模块，产生由被建模变量之间物理感知的因果效应关系所引导的预测。

sentences.en: Extensive experimentation demonstrates that our method is robust to noisy and limited data, outperforming existing models across a variety of challenging synthetic tasks and benchmark datasets.
sentences.zh: 大量实验表明，我们的方法对嘈杂、有限的数据具有稳健性，在多种具有挑战性的合成任务与基准数据集上优于现有模型。

sentences.en: We further evaluate our method on real-world graph signals and observe superior forecasting performance, achieved by effectively utilizing causal signals from prior physics knowledge.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步在真实世界的图信号上评估我们的方法，观察到通过有效利用先前物理知识中的因果信号获得了更优的预测性能。

title_en: Physics-Guided Motion Loss for Video Generation Model
title_zh: 面向视频生成模型的物理引导运动损失

sentences.en: Current video diffusion models generate visually compelling content but often struggle with physical motion, producing subtle artifacts like rubber-sheet deformations and  inconsistent object motion.
sentences.zh: 当前的视频扩散模型能生成视觉上引人入胜的内容，但在物理运动上常显不足，产生诸如橡胶板变形和物体运动不一致等细微伪影。

sentences.en: We introduce a frequency-domain physics prior that improves  motion plausibility without modifying model architectures.
sentences.zh: 我们引入一个频域物理先验，在不修改模型架构的情况下提升运动合理性。

sentences.en: Our method decomposes common  motion patterns (translation, rotation, scaling) into lightweight spectral losses.
sentences.zh: 我们的方法将常见的运动模式（平移、旋转、缩放）分解为轻量级的频谱损失。

sentences.en: Applied to Open-Sora, MVDIT, and Hunyuan, our approach improves both motion accuracy and action recognition by ∼11\% on average on OpenVID-1M (relative), while maintaining visual quality.
sentences.zh: 将我们的方法应用于Open-Sora、MVDIT和Hunyuan上，在OpenVID-1M上平均将运动精度与动作识别（相对值）提升了约11\%，同时保持了视觉质量。

sentences.en: Additional results on Wan 2.1-14B show consistent gains on video-quality and physics-oriented metrics.
sentences.zh: 在Wan 2.1-14B上的补充结果显示，在视频质量与面向物理的指标上均取得了一致的增益。

sentences.en: User studies show 74-83\% preference for our physics-enhanced videos.
sentences.zh: 用户研究显示，74-83\%的受试者偏爱我们的物理增强视频。

sentences.en: It also reduces warping error by 22-37\% (depending on the backbone) and improves temporal consistency scores.
sentences.zh: 它还（视骨干网络而定）将翘曲误差降低了22-37\%，并改善了时间一致性分数。

sentences.en: These results indicate that simple, global spectral cues are an effective drop-in regularizer for physically plausible motion in video diffusion.
sentences.zh: 这些结果表明，简单、全局的频谱线索是视频扩散中实现物理合理运动的有效即插即用正则化器。

title_en: Physics-informed coarsening for multigrid graph neural networks surrogates
title_zh: 物理信息的粗化用于多重网格图神经网络代理

sentences.en: Learning-based surrogates for partial differential equations have recently matched the accuracy of classical solvers while achieving orders-of-magnitude speedups, predominantly in fluid settings and structured geometries.
sentences.zh: 基于学习的偏微分方程代理近期已在精度上匹敌经典求解器，同时实现数量级的加速，主要见于流体设定与结构化几何中。

sentences.en: In contrast, robust surrogates for deformable solids remain underexplored, despite the presence of nonlinear elasticity, plasticity, and transient behavior that challenge standard architectures.
sentences.zh: 相比之下，可变形固体的稳健代理仍未得到充分探索，尽管非线性弹性、塑性与瞬态行为对标准架构构成挑战。

sentences.en: We introduce a multigrid graph neural network for solid mechanics that couples an *encoder-processor-decoder* backbone with a physics-informed coarsening strategy.
sentences.zh: 我们为一个固体力学多重网格图神经网络引入，它将*编码器-处理器-解码器*骨干与物理信息的粗化策略相结合。

sentences.en: Instead of downsampling via geometric heuristics, our method scores nodes using a residual-based measure of local physical activity and preferentially retains regions of high strain or stress concentration, allocating multiscale capacity where it is most needed.
sentences.zh: 我们的方法不使用几何启发式进行下采样，而是利用基于残差的局部物理活动度量对节点打分，优先保留高应变或高应力集中的区域，在最需要的地方分配多尺度容量。

sentences.en: This preserves long-range interactions through hierarchical message passing while improving stability over long rollouts.
sentences.zh: 这通过层次化消息传递保留了长程相互作用，同时提高了长轨迹展开的稳定性。

sentences.en: We evaluate on multiple datasets covering linear, nonlinear, and transient regimes, and observe consistent gains in accuracy and rollout stability compared to standard sampling baselines.
sentences.zh: 我们在涵盖线性、非线性和瞬态机制的多个数据集上进行评估，观察到与标准采样基线相比，在精度与轨迹展开稳定性方面均有一致的提升。

sentences.en: Our results highlight the importance of physics-informed coarsening for scalable surrogate modeling in solid mechanics.
sentences.zh: 我们的结果凸显了物理信息粗化对固体力学中可扩展代理建模的重要性。

title_en: Physics-Informed Diffusion Models in Spectral Space
title_zh: 谱空间中的物理信息扩散模型

sentences.en: We propose physics-informed spectral diffusion (PISD), a methodology that combines generative latent diffusion models with physics-informed machine learning to generate solutions of partial differential equations (PDEs) conditioned on partial observations, which includes, in particular, forward and inverse PDE problems.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了物理信息谱扩散（PISD），一种将生成式潜在扩散模型与物理信息机器学习相结合的方法，以生成以部分观测为条件的偏微分方程（PDE）解，尤其包括前向与逆向PDE问题。

sentences.en: We learn the joint distribution of PDE parameters and solutions via a diffusion process in a latent space of scaled spectral representations, where Gaussian noise corresponds to functions with controlled regularity.
sentences.zh: 我们在缩放频谱表示的潜在空间中通过扩散过程学习PDE参数与解的联合分布，其中高斯噪声对应于具有受控正则性的函数。

sentences.en: This spectral formulation enables significant dimensionality reduction compared to grid-based diffusion models and ensures that the induced process in function space remains within a class of functions for which the PDE operators are well defined.
sentences.zh: 这种谱公式与基于网格的扩散模型相比能够显著降低维数，并确保函数空间中诱导的过程保持在PDE算子有良好定义的一类函数内。

sentences.en: Building on diffusion posterior sampling, we enforce physics-informed constraints and measurement conditions during inference, applying Adam-based updates at each diffusion step.
sentences.zh: 基于扩散后验采样，我们在推理期间强制物理信息约束与测量条件，在每个扩散步骤应用基于Adam的更新。

sentences.en: We evaluate the proposed approach on Poisson, Helmholtz, and incompressible Navier-Stokes equations, demonstrating improved accuracy and computational efficiency compared with existing diffusion-based PDE solvers, which are state of the art for sparse observations.
sentences.zh: 我们对所提方法在Poisson、Helmholtz和不可压缩Navier-Stokes方程上进行评估，证明与现有基于扩散的PDE求解器（在稀疏观测下属于最先进水平）相比，精度与计算效率都有所提高。

sentences.en: Code is available at https://github.com/deeplearningmethods/PISD.
sentences.zh: 代码可在 https://github.com/deeplearningmethods/PISD 获取。

title_en: Physics-Informed Distillation of Diffusion Models for PDE-Constrained Generation
title_zh: 面向PDE约束生成的扩散模型物理信息蒸馏

sentences.en: Diffusion models show growing promise for generative modeling of physical systems, but enforcing partial differential equation (PDE) constraints directly is infeasible during the stochastic denoising process.
sentences.zh: 扩散模型在物理系统的生成建模中展现出日益增长的前景，但在随机去噪过程中直接施加偏微分方程（PDE）约束是不现实的。

sentences.en: Current methods apply constraints to the expected clean sample, incurring a Jensen’s Gap that forces a trade-off between PDE satisfaction and generative accuracy.
sentences.zh: 当前的方法对期望的干净样本施加约束，从而产生Jensen间隙，迫使人们在PDE满足度与生成精度之间进行权衡。

sentences.en: To bridge this gap, we propose Physics-Informed Distillation of Diffusion Models (PIDDM), a simple yet effective post-hoc distillation strategy that enforces PDE constraints after training.
sentences.zh: 为弥合这一差距，我们提出了扩散模型的物理信息蒸馏（PIDDM），一种简单而有效的训练后蒸馏策略，在训练后施加PDE约束。

sentences.en: PIDDM enables fast single-step generation while improving both physical consistency and sample quality, supporting forward/inverse problems and reconstruction from partial observations.
sentences.zh: PIDDM支持快速单步生成，同时改善物理一致性与样本质量，支持前向/逆向问题以及从部分观测中进行重建。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments across PDE benchmarks show PIDDM outperforms recent baselines, such as PIDM, DiffusionPDE, and ECI-sampling, in both accuracy and constraint satisfaction, with lower computation and minimal hyperparameter tuning, offering a more efficient pathway to physics-informed diffusion models.
sentences.zh: 跨PDE基准的大量实验表明，PIDDM在精度与约束满足度两方面都优于近期基线（如PIDM、DiffusionPDE和ECI-sampling），且计算量更低、超参数调优最少，为物理信息扩散模型提供了一条更高效的路径。

title_en: Physics-informed Neural Operator Learning for Nonlinear Grad-Shafranov Equation
title_zh: 用于非线性Grad-Shafranov方程的物理信息神经算子学习

sentences.en: AI for fusion requires bridging a critical ``sim-to-real'' gap: simulation-trained models must generalize reliably under distribution shifts in safety-critical workflows.
sentences.zh: 融合AI需要弥合一个关键的仿真到真实（sim-to-real）差距：在安全关键工作流中，仿真训练模型必须在分布偏移下可靠地泛化。

sentences.en: Focusing on the nonlinear Grad-Shafranov equation (GSE), we develop and analyze a physics-anchored operator-learning framework for fixed-boundary equilibrium prediction.
sentences.zh: 聚焦于非线性Grad-Shafranov方程（GSE），我们开发并分析了一个物理锚定的算子学习框架，用于固定边界平衡预测。

sentences.en: The framework combines data anchors with PDE residual constraints and uses a physics-motivated Transformer-KAN Neural Operator (TKNO) to capture global elliptic coupling and nonlinear source response.
sentences.zh: 该框架将数据锚点与PDE残差约束相结合，并使用物理驱动的Transformer-KAN神经算子（TKNO）来捕捉全局椭圆耦合与非线性源响应。

sentences.en: Under multi-parameter distribution shifts, our analysis shows that data-only surrogates can develop severe OOD tails, while physics-only training may converge to incorrect solution branches; by combining sparse data anchors with PDE constraints, physics-anchored training reduces worst-tail errors on shape-driven and joint shifts.
sentences.zh: 在多参数分布偏移下，我们的分析表明，纯数据代理可能产生严重的分布外（OOD）尾部，而纯物理训练可能收敛到错误的解分支；通过将稀疏数据锚点与PDE约束相结合，物理锚定训练在形状驱动与联合偏移下减少了最差尾部误差。

sentences.en: Mechanism diagnostics indicate that data anchors suppress branch-scale failures, whereas PDE residuals reduce OOD-induced high-frequency error amplification.
sentences.zh: 机制诊断表明，数据锚点能抑制分支级失效，而PDE残差能减少OOD引起的高频误差放大。

sentences.en: Evaluated on EXL-50U discharge inputs against the device's operational equilibrium solver, the model achieves close agreement (RMSE $<$ 1.3\%) with millisecond-level inference.
sentences.zh: 在EXL-50U放电输入上对照该装置运行平衡求解器进行评估，模型达到了与毫秒级推理的接近一致性（RMSE $< 1.3\\%$）。

sentences.en: These results provide a practical route toward physically reliable AI surrogates for fusion workflows.
sentences.zh: 这些结果为融合工作流提供了通往物理可靠AI代理的实用路径。

sentences.en: Our code will be available at https://github.com/dsqzhou/physics-anchored-gse.
sentences.zh: 我们的代码将在 https://github.com/dsqzhou/physics-anchored-gse 提供。

title_en: Physics-Informed Pre-training on Efficient Electron-Density Images for Organic Material Property Prediction
title_zh: 在高效电子密度图像上的物理信息预训练用于有机材料性质预测

sentences.en: Precise property prediction of organic materials is pivotal for next-generation electronic and energy devices.
sentences.zh: 有机材料性质的精确预测对下一代电子与能源器件至关重要。

sentences.en: In density functional theory (DFT), the electron density (ED) serves as the fundamental determinant of material properties.
sentences.zh: 在密度泛函理论（DFT）中，电子密度（ED）是材料性质的基本决定因素。

sentences.en: Yet, establishing it as an input modality for material property prediction has been impeded by two practical barriers: scarce large-scale ED data and the enormous computational complexity of ED representation.
sentences.zh: 然而，将其确立为材料性质预测的输入模态一直受两个实际障碍的阻碍着大规模ED数据稀缺以及ED表示的计算复杂度巨大。

sentences.en: To bridge these gaps, we introduce VisionED, an efficient physics-informed model pre-trained on electron-density images.
sentences.zh: 为弥合这些差距，我们引入了VisionED，一个在电子密度图像上预训练的高效物理信息模型。

sentences.en: We curate a dataset of 2 million molecules and represent ED as multi-shot images that efficiently encode both geometric and electronic structure.
sentences.zh: 我们整理了一个包含200万个分子的数据集，并将ED表示为多镜头图像，高效编码了几何与电子结构。

sentences.en: VisionED is then pre-trained on 12 million multi-shot ED images via cross-scale, physics-informed pretext tasks.
sentences.zh: 随后，通过跨尺度、物理信息的预文本任务，在1200万张多镜头ED图像上预训练VisionED。

sentences.en: Empirical evaluations on photovoltaic and organic chromophore datasets show that VisionED outperforms state-of-the-art baselines by up to 27.0\%, exhibiting superior robustness under distribution shifts and data scarcity.
sentences.zh: 对光伏与有机发色团数据集的实证评估表明，VisionED在最先进的基线上提升了最高27.0\\%，在分布偏移与数据稀缺下展现出卓越的稳健性。

sentences.en: Notably, the model generalizes to unseen device-scale applications, successfully recovering experimental trends and mixing-ratio effects in ternary blends with an average accuracy of 92.77\%.
sentences.zh: 值得注意的是，该模型泛化到未见过的器件级应用，成功恢复了三元共混物中的实验趋势与混合比例效应，平均精度达92.77\\%。

sentences.en: Moreover, relative to the previous ED point cloud, the ED image improves performance by 26.2\% with 2.6$\times$ fewer memory and 4.6$\times$ lower time.
sentences.zh: 此外，相对于先前的ED点云，ED图像以2.6$\\times$更低的内存和4.6$\\times$更低的时间将性能提升了26.2\\%。

sentences.en: The code and data are available at https://github.com/ZhixiangCheng/VisionED.
sentences.zh: 代码与数据可在 https://github.com/ZhixiangCheng/VisionED 获取。

title_en: Physics-Informed Residual Flows
title_zh: 物理信息残差流

sentences.en: Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) embed physical laws into deep learning models.
sentences.zh: 物理信息神经网络（PINN）将物理定律嵌入深度学习模型。

sentences.en: However, conventional PINNs often suffer from failure modes leading to inaccurate solutions.
sentences.zh: 然而，传统的PINN常常遭受导致不精确解的失效模式。

sentences.en: We trace these failure modes to two structural pathologies: gradient shattering, where gradients degrade with depth and provide little training signal, and flow mismatch, where training pushes predictions along trajectories that diverge from the PDE solution path.
sentences.zh: 我们将这些失效模式追溯到两种结构病态：梯度碎裂，即梯度随深度加深而退化并提供很少的训练信号；以及流不匹配，即训练将预测推至偏离PDE解路径的轨迹。

sentences.en: We introduce ResPINNs, which reformulate PINNs as residual flows, networks that iteratively refine their own predictions through explicit corrective steps, in the spirit of classical iterative solvers.
sentences.zh: 我们引入了ResPINN，它将PINN重构为残差流，即通过显式的修正步骤迭代精化自身预测的网络，其思路承袭自经典的迭代求解器。

sentences.en: Our analysis shows that this design mitigates both pathologies by keeping updates aligned with descent and by preserving informative gradients across depth.
sentences.zh: 我们的分析表明，这种设计通过保持更新与下降方向一致并跨深度保留信息丰富的梯度，缓解了这两种病态。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments on PDE benchmarks confirm that ResPINNs achieve higher accuracy with substantially fewer parameters than conventional architectures.
sentences.zh: 在PDE基准上的大量实验证实，与传统架构相比，ResPINN以少得多的参数实现了更高的精度。

title_en: Physiology as Language: Translating Respiration to EEG during Sleep
title_zh: 生理学即语言：将睡眠期间的呼吸翻译为EEG

sentences.en: This paper introduces a novel cross-physiology translation task: synthesizing sleep electroencephalography (EEG) from respiration signals.
sentences.zh: 本文引入了一个新的跨生理学翻译任务：从呼吸信号合成睡眠脑电图（EEG）。

sentences.en: To address the significant complexity gap between the two modalities, we propose a waveform-conditional generative framework that preserves fine-grained respiratory dynamics while constraining the EEG target space through discrete tokenization.
sentences.zh: 为解决这两种模态之间显著的复杂性差距，我们提出了一个波形条件的生成式框架，它保留细粒度的呼吸动态，同时通过离散词元化约束EEG目标空间。

sentences.en: Trained on over 28,000 individuals, our model achieves a 7% Mean Absolute Error in EEG spectrogram reconstruction.
sentences.zh: 在超过28,000名个体上训练后，我们的模型在EEG频谱图重建中实现了7%的平均绝对误差。

sentences.en: Beyond reconstruction, the synthesized EEG supports downstream tasks with performance comparable to ground truth EEG on age estimation (MAE 5.0 vs. 5.1 years), sex detection (AUROC 0.81 vs. 0.82), and sleep staging (Accuracy 0.84 vs. 0.88), significantly outperforming baselines trained directly on breathing.
sentences.zh: 除重建之外，合成的EEG支持下游任务的性能与真实EEG相当：年龄估计（MAE 5.0对5.1年）、性别检测（AUROC 0.81对0.82）以及睡眠分期（准确率0.84对0.88），显著优于直接基于呼吸训练的基线。

sentences.en: Finally, we demonstrate that the framework generalizes to contactless sensing by synthesizing EEG from wireless radio-frequency reflections, highlighting the feasibility of remote, non-contact neurological assessment during sleep.
sentences.zh: 最后，我们证明该框架通过从无线射频反射合成EEG，可泛化到非接触式传感，凸显了睡眠期间远程、非接触神经评估的可行性。

title_en: Physiology-Aware Masked Cross-Modal Reconstruction for Biosignal Representation Learning
title_zh: 生理感知的掩码跨模态重建用于生物信号表示学习

sentences.en: Biosignals acquired from different locations on the body often provide temporally ordered views of the same underlying physiological process.
sentences.zh: 从身体不同部位采集的生物信号往往提供同一潜在生理过程在时间上有序的视图。

sentences.en: However, most existing self-supervised learning methods treat these signals as interchangeable views, overlooking the directional temporal dynamics that link them.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有的大多数自监督学习方法将这些信号视为可互换的视图，忽视了连接它们的方向性时间动态。

sentences.en: A canonical example is the relationship between electrocardiography (ECG), which captures the electrical activation initiating each heartbeat, and photoplethysmography (PPG), which records the resulting peripheral pulse delayed by vascular dynamics.
sentences.zh: 一个典型的例子是心电图（ECG）与光电容积脉搏波（PPG）之间的关系：ECG捕捉启动每次心跳的电激活，而PPG记录因血管动力学而延迟的末梢脉搏。

sentences.en: To capture this structured relationship, we introduce xMAE, a biosignal pretraining framework that leverages masked cross-modal reconstruction across temporally ordered biosignals as a training-time constraint to encourage physiologically meaningful timing structure in the learned representations.
sentences.zh: 为捕捉这种结构化关系，我们引入了xMAE，一个生物信号预训练框架，它利用跨时间有序生物信号的掩码跨模态重建作为训练时约束，以鼓励所学表示中具有生理意义的时间结构。

sentences.en: We show that pretraining with xMAE yields representations that outperform both unimodal and multimodal baselines on 15 of 19 downstream tasks, including cardiovascular outcome prediction, abnormal laboratory test detection, sleep staging, and demographic inference, while generalizing across devices, body locations, and acquisition settings.
sentences.zh: 我们表明，使用xMAE进行预训练所得表示在19个下游任务中的15个上优于单模态与多模态基线，包括心血管结局预测、异常实验室检测、睡眠分期与人口统计推断，同时跨设备、身体部位与采集设置泛化。

sentences.en: Further analysis suggests that the ECG--PPG timing structure is reflected in the learned PPG representations.
sentences.zh: 进一步分析表明，ECG--PPG时间结构反映在学习到的PPG表示中。

sentences.en: Code is available at https://github.com/hzhou3/xMAE.
sentences.zh: 代码可在 https://github.com/hzhou3/xMAE 获取。

title_en: Pianist Transformer: Towards Expressive Piano Performance Rendering via Scalable Self-Supervised Pre-Training
title_zh: Pianist Transformer：通过可扩展的自监督预训练实现富有表现力的钢琴演奏渲染

sentences.en: Existing methods for expressive music performance rendering rely on supervised learning over small labeled datasets, which limits scaling of both data volume and model size, despite the availability of vast unlabeled music, as in vision and language.
sentences.zh: 现有的表达性音乐演奏渲染方法依赖在小型标注数据集上的监督学习，这限制了数据量与模型规模的扩展，尽管与视觉和语言领域一样，存在海量的无标注音乐数据。

sentences.en: To address this gap, we introduce Pianist Transformer, with three key contributions: 1) introducing large-scale self-supervised learning into expressive piano performance rendering through a unified Musical Instrument Digital Interface (MIDI) representation, enabling pre-training on 10B tokens of unlabeled MIDI data;
sentences.zh: 为弥补这一差距，我们引入了Pianist Transformer，它有三项关键贡献：1）通过统一的乐器数字接口（MIDI）表示，将大规模自监督学习引入表达性钢琴演奏渲染，实现了在100亿词元的无标注MIDI数据上进行预训练；

sentences.en: 2) an efficient asymmetric Transformer with note-level compression, substantially improving training efficiency, memory usage, and inference speed for long-context music modeling;
sentences.zh: 2）一个具有音符级压缩的高效非对称Transformer，显著提升了长上下文音乐建模的训练效率、内存占用与推理速度；

sentences.en: 3) a state-of-the-art rendering model with an editable workflow, achieving strong objective and subjective results and enabling integration into real-world music production workflows.
sentences.zh: 3）一个具有可编辑流程的最先进渲染模型，取得了强的主客观结果，并能够集成到真实的音乐制作流程中。

sentences.en: Overall, Pianist Transformer outlines a scalable path toward human-like performance synthesis in the music domain.
sentences.zh: 总体而言，Pianist Transformer为音乐领域中类人的演奏合成勾勒出一条可扩展的路径。

sentences.en: Code, audio samples, and model checkpoints are available on our project page: https://yhj137.github.io/pianist-transformer-demo/.
sentences.zh: 代码、音频样本与模型检查点均可在我们的项目页面获取： https://yhj137.github.io/pianist-transformer-demo/ 。

title_en: PICACO: Pluralistic In-Context Value Alignment via Total Correlation Optimization
title_zh: PICACO：通过总相关性优化实现多元化上下文价值对齐

sentences.en: In-Context Learning has shown great potential for aligning Large Language Models (LLMs) with human values, helping reduce harmful outputs and accommodate diverse preferences without costly post-training, known as *In-Context Alignment* (ICA).
sentences.zh: 上下文学习在使大型语言模型（LLM）与人类价值对齐方面展现出巨大潜力，无需成本高昂的后训练即可帮助减少有害输出并容纳多样化的偏好，这被称为*上下文对齐*（ICA）。

sentences.en: However, LLMs' comprehension of input prompts remains agnostic, limiting ICA's ability to address value tensions—human values are inherently *pluralistic*, often imposing conflicting demands, *e.g.*, stimulation vs. tradition.
sentences.zh: 然而，LLM对输入提示的理解仍是不知情的，这限制了ICA应对价值冲突的能力——人类价值本质上是*多元化的*，常常施加相互冲突的要求，*例如*，刺激与传统。

sentences.en: Current ICA methods therefore face the *Instruction Bottleneck* challenge, where LLMs struggle to reconcile multiple intended values within a single prompt, leading to incomplete or biased alignment.
sentences.zh: 因此，当前的ICA方法面临*指令瓶颈*挑战，即LLM难以在单个提示中调和多种意图价值，导致对齐不完整或有偏。

sentences.en: To address this, we propose **PICACO**, a novel pluralistic ICA method.
sentences.zh: 为解决这一问题，我们提出了**PICACO**，一种新颖的多元化ICA方法。

sentences.en: Without fine-tuning, PICACO optimizes a meta-instruction that incorporates multiple values to better elicit LLMs' understanding of them and improve alignment.
sentences.zh: 无需微调，PICACO便优化一个融入多种价值的元指令，以更好地激发LLM对它们的理解并改进对齐。

sentences.en: This is achieved by maximizing the total correlation between specified values and LLM responses, which theoretically reinforces value conformity and reduces distractive noise, resulting in more effective instructions.
sentences.zh: 这是通过最大化指定价值与LLM响应之间的总相关性实现的，这在理论上强化了价值一致性并减少干扰噪声，从而产生更有效的指令。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments on five value sets show that PICACO works well with both black-box and open-source LLMs, outperforms several recent strong baselines, and achieves a better balance across up to 8 distinct values.
sentences.zh: 在五个价值集上的大量实验表明，PICACO能很好地适用于黑盒与开源LLM，优于多个近期强基线，并在最多8种不同价值之间实现了更好的平衡。

title_en: PINE: Pruning Boosted Tree Ensembles with Conformal In-Distribution Prediction Equivalence
title_zh: PINE：基于同分布预测等价的提升树集成剪枝

sentences.en: Tree ensembles are machine learning models with strong predictive performance and interpretability, and remain widely used for tabular data.
sentences.zh: 树集成是预测性能强且可解释的机器学习模型，仍广泛用于表格数据。

sentences.en: Standard pruning methods for tree ensembles typically optimize an accuracy-compression trade-off and may change a subset of predictions, potentially compromising decision consistency.
sentences.zh: 树集成的标准剪枝方法通常优化精度-压缩权衡，并可能改变一部分预测，从而可能损害决策一致性。

sentences.en: Faithful pruning methods address this issue by preserving prediction equivalence over the entire input space, but this requirement leads to lower compression ratios.
sentences.zh: 忠实剪枝方法通过在整个输入空间上保持预测等价来解决这一问题，但这种要求导致较低的压缩比。

sentences.en: We propose **PINE**, a pruning method that provides strong guarantees within an in-distribution region.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了**PINE**，一种在同分布区域内提供强保证的剪枝方法。

sentences.en: PINE preserves prediction equivalence within this region and controls the region size using a single parameter $\alpha$ via conformal calibration.
sentences.zh: PINE在该区域内保持预测等价，并通过共形校准使用单个参数$\alpha$控制区域大小。

sentences.en: Experiments on 12 public tabular datasets show that PINE improves the compression ratio by up to 30% while preserving predictions at a comparable level to existing faithful pruning methods.
sentences.zh: 在12个公开表格数据集上的实验表明，PINE将压缩比提高了最多30%，同时在与现有忠实剪枝方法相当的水平上保持预测。

title_en: PINNfluence: Interpreting PINNs through Influence Functions
title_zh: PINNfluence：通过影响函数解释PINN

sentences.en: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) have emerged as a powerful deep learning approach for solving partial differential equations (PDEs) in the physical sciences, yet their behavior remains largely opaque and is typically understood through failure mode analyses rather than explicit interpretability.
sentences.zh: 物理信息神经网络（PINN）已经成为自然科学中求解偏微分方程（PDE）的有力深度学习算法，然而其行为在很大程度上仍不透明，通常是通过失效模式分析而非显式可解释性来理解。

sentences.en: To address this issue, we introduce PINNfluence, a training data attribution framework for interpreting PINNs based on influence functions.
sentences.zh: 为解决这一问题，我们引入了PINNfluence，一个基于影响函数、用于解释PINN的训练数据归因框架。

sentences.en: By extending influence functions to composite physics-informed training objectives, we enable fine-grained attribution between predictions, loss components, and training data points.
sentences.zh: 通过将影响函数扩展到复合的物理信息训练目标，我们实现了预测、损失分量与训练数据点之间的细粒度归因。

sentences.en: Through benchmark experiments across various PDEs, we demonstrate that influence patterns provide granular diagnostics that distinguish structural characteristics across well-trained and poorly-trained PINNs.
sentences.zh: 跨多种PDE的基准实验表明，影响模式提供了细粒度诊断，能够区分训练良好与训练不良的PINN的结构特征。

sentences.en: PINNfluence thus opens a new avenue for understanding and improving the reliability of PINNs through the lens of their data.
sentences.zh: 因此，PINNfluence通过数据视角为理解和改进PINN的可靠性开辟了新途径。

title_en: PinTok: Tokenizers Deserve Dedicated Pinned CPU-Compute and Memory
title_zh: PinTok：分词器值得拥有专用的CPU固定计算与内存

sentences.en: Tokenization is the first point of contact between large language models (LLMs) and text data, yet it has not been viewed by many as a component of LLMs worth accelerating.
sentences.zh: 分词是大型语言模型（LLM）与文本数据的第一个接触点，然而许多人并未将分词视为LLM中值得加速的组件。

sentences.en: During inference, tokenizers typically rely on simple dictionary lookups and are executed on CPUs as standard processes.
sentences.zh: 在推理期间，分词器通常依赖简单的字典查找，并以标准进程的形式在CPU上执行。

sentences.en: This approach, however, introduces significant overhead from scheduling delays, core selection, data copying, and other system-level costs.
sentences.zh: 然而，这种方法会引入来自调度延迟、核心选择、数据复制及其他系统级成本的显著开销。

sentences.en: These inefficiencies become problematic in latency-sensitive applications such as embedding, small language models, and agentic AI.
sentences.zh: 这些低效在嵌入、小语言模型与智能体AI等对延迟敏感的应用中成为问题。

sentences.en: In this paper, we present the Pinned Tokenizer (PinTok), a novel tokenizer architecture that reduces redundant hardware, operating system, and networking overhead through three key innovations: core and memory pinning, scheduling and context switch avoidance, and duplicate network packet copy and processing avoidance.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们提出了固定分词器（PinTok），一种新颖的分词器架构，通过三项关键创新减少冗余的硬件、操作系统与网络开销：核心与内存固定、调度与上下文切换规避，以及重复网络数据包复制与处理的规避。

sentences.en: Our implementation of PinTok can serve as a drop-in replacement for existing tokenizer deployments, delivering latency reductions of up to 95% (average), 97% (P50), 94% (P90), and 87% (P99) along with throughput improvements of up to 2,084%.
sentences.zh: 我们的PinTok实现可以作为现有分词器部署的即插即用替代品，带来平均95%、P50 97%、P90 94%与P99 87%的延迟降低，以及最高2,084%的吞吐量提升。

title_en: PipeSD: An Efficient Cloud-Edge Collaborative Pipeline Inference Framework with Speculative Decoding
title_zh: PipeSD：一个带推测解码的高效云端协同流水线推理框架

sentences.en: Speculative decoding can significantly accelerate LLM inference,  especially given that its cloud-edge collaborative deployment offers cloud workload offloading,  offline robustness, and privacy enhancement.
sentences.zh: 推测解码可以显著加速LLM推理，尤其是其云端协同部署提供了云工作负载卸载、离线稳健性与隐私增强。

sentences.en: However, existing collaborative inference frameworks with speculative decoding are constrained by  (i) sequential token generation and communication with low resource utilization,  and (ii) inflexible cloud non-autoregressive verification (NAV) triggering that induces premature verification or costly rollbacks.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有的带推测解码的协同推理框架受到（i）顺序的词元生成与通信导致资源利用率低，以及（ii）不灵活的云端非自回归验证（NAV）触发导致过早验证或代价高昂的回滚的制约。

sentences.en: In this paper, we propose PipeSD, an efficient cloud-edge collaborative pipeline inference framework with speculative decoding.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们提出了PipeSD，一个带推测解码的高效云端协同流水线推理框架。

sentences.en: PipeSD overlaps token generation and communication by a token-batch pipeline scheduling mechanism optimized by dynamic programming,  and improves verification flexibility through a dual-threshold NAV triggering mechanism with a lightweight Bayesian optimization autotuner.
sentences.zh: PipeSD通过由动态规划优化的词元批量流水线调度机制重叠词元生成与通信，并通过带轻量贝叶斯优化自动调参器的双阈值NAV触发机制改进验证灵活性。

sentences.en: We implement PipeSD using llama-cpp-python, PyTorch, and FastAPI,  and evaluate it on a real-world cloud-edge testbed  with two draft-target model pairs across four scenarios.
sentences.zh: 我们使用llama-cpp-python、PyTorch与FastAPI实现PipeSD，并在真实世界的云端测试床上以两对草稿-目标模型、跨四种场景进行评估。

sentences.en: Results show that PipeSD consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines,  achieving $1.16\times$-$2.16\times$ speedup and  reducing energy consumption by $14.3$%-$25.3$%.
sentences.zh: 结果表明，PipeSD始终优于最先进的基线，实现了$1.16\times$-$2.16\times$的加速，并将能耗降低了$14.3$%-$25.3$%。

sentences.en: Our code is available at https://github.com/Ghanyunhe/PipeSD.
sentences.zh: 我们的代码可在 https://github.com/Ghanyunhe/PipeSD 获取。

title_en: PISA: Privacy-Preserving Split Adaptation with Model IP Protection
title_zh: PISA：带模型IP保护的隐私保护拆分适配

sentences.en: Fine-tuning Large Language Models (LLMs) enables data holders to construct proprietary, task-specific models by leveraging external high-performance computing infrastructure.
sentences.zh: 对大型语言模型（LLM）进行微调，使数据持有者能够借助外部高性能计算基础设施构建专有的、任务特定的模型。

sentences.en: However, existing paradigms typically address data privacy and model intellectual property (IP) in isolation, failing to simultaneously uphold both constraints.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有范式通常孤立地处理数据隐私与模型知识产权（IP），无法同时满足这两项约束。

sentences.en: Privacy-prioritized methods compromise model IP by hosting parameters remotely, while IP-oriented collaborative schemes relying on end-to-end gradient flows inherently violate strict data privacy standards.
sentences.zh: 以隐私为先的方法通过远程托管参数而损害模型IP，而依赖端到端梯度流的面向IP的协同方案则固有地违反严格的数据隐私标准。

sentences.en: To address these challenges, we present **PISA** (**P**rivacy-preserving and **I**P-protected **S**plit **A**daptation), a split fine-tuning framework designed to preserve both data privacy and model IP while maintaining high utility.
sentences.zh: 为应对这些挑战，我们提出了**PISA**（**P**rivacy-preserving and **I**P-protected **S**plit **A**daptation，即隐私保护且IP受保护的拆分适配），一个拆分微调框架，旨在在保持高可用性的同时兼顾数据隐私与模型IP。

sentences.en: In PISA, we propose three methods: a Manifold Rectification Pre-training (MRP) method to equip the server-side model with intrinsic robustness against privacy-induced distribution shifts; a Dual-Stream Semantic Compensation (DSC) method to recover feature utility using local clean data as priors; and a Utility-Aware Gradient Rectification (UGR) method to adaptively maximize the performance of the parameter-constrained local model.
sentences.zh: 在PISA中，我们提出了三种方法：一种流形校正预训练（MRP）方法，为服务端模型赋予对隐私诱导的分布偏移的内在稳健性；一种双流语义补偿（DSC）方法，以本地干净数据为先验恢复特征可用性；以及一种可用性感知的梯度校正（UGR）方法，自适应地最大化受参数约束的本地模型的性能。

sentences.en: Experiments on GLUE show that PISA ensures dual protection and delivers a substantial 23.0\% performance gain over the privacy-prioritized baseline under strict privacy budgets.
sentences.zh: 在GLUE上的实验表明，PISA在严格的隐私预算下确保了双重保护，并相比以隐私为先的基线带来了显著的23.0\%性能提升。

title_en: PISCES: Annotation-free Text-to-Video Post-Training via Optimal Transport-Aligned Rewards
title_zh: PISCES：通过最优传输对齐奖励实现无标注的文生视频后训练

sentences.en: Text-to-video (T2V) generation aims to synthesize videos with high visual quality and temporal consistency that are semantically aligned with input text.
sentences.zh: 文生视频（T2V）生成旨在合成与输入文本语义对齐、且具有高视觉质量与时间一致性的视频。

sentences.en: Reward-based post-training has emerged as a promising direction to improve the quality and semantic alignment of generated videos.
sentences.zh: 基于奖励的后训练已成为改善生成视频质量与语义对齐的有前景方向。

sentences.en: However, recent methods either rely on large-scale human preference annotations or operate on misaligned embeddings from pre-trained vision-language models, leading to limited scalability or suboptimal supervision.
sentences.zh: 然而，近期方法要么依赖大规模人工偏好标注，要么在预训练视觉-语言模型的错位嵌入上运作，导致可扩展性有限或监督次优。

sentences.en: We present PISCES, an annotation-free post-training algorithm that addresses these limitations via a novel Dual Optimal Transport (OT)-aligned Rewards module.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了PISCES，一种无标注的后训练算法，通过一个新颖的双最优传输（OT）对齐奖励模块解决这些局限。

sentences.en: To align reward signals with human judgment, PISCES uses OT to bridge text and video embeddings at both distributional and discrete token levels, enabling reward supervision to fulfill two objectives: (i) a Distributional OT-aligned Quality Reward that captures overall visual quality and temporal coherence; and (ii) a Discrete Token-level OT-aligned Semantic Reward that enforces semantic, spatio-temporal correspondence between text and video tokens.
sentences.zh: 为将奖励信号与人类判断对齐，PISCES使用OT在分布级与离散词元级桥接文本与视频嵌入，使奖励监督满足两个目标：（i）分布级OT对齐的质量奖励，捕捉整体视觉质量与时间连贯性；以及（ii）离散词元级OT对齐的语义奖励，强化文本与视频词元之间的语义、时空对应。

sentences.en: To our knowledge, PISCES is the first to improve annotation-free reward supervision in generative post-training through the lens of OT.
sentences.zh: 据我们所知，PISCES是首个通过OT视角改进生成式后训练中无标注奖励监督的工作。

sentences.en: Experiments on both short- and long-video generation show that PISCES outperforms both annotation-based and annotation-free methods on VBench across Quality and Semantic scores, with human preference studies further validating its effectiveness.
sentences.zh: 在短视频与长视频生成上的实验表明，PISCES在VBench的质量与语义得分上均优于基于标注的和无标注的方法，人工偏好研究进一步验证了其有效性。

sentences.en: We show that the Dual OT-aligned Rewards module is compatible with multiple optimization paradigms, including direct backpropagation and reinforcement learning fine-tuning.
sentences.zh: 我们表明，双OT对齐奖励模块与多种优化范式兼容，包括直接反向传播与强化学习微调。

title_en: Pix2Key: Controllable Open-Vocabulary Retrieval with Semantic Decomposition and Self-Supervised Visual Dictionary Learning
title_zh: Pix2Key：基于语义分解与自监督视觉字典学习的可控开放词汇检索

sentences.en: Composed image retrieval uses a reference image plus a natural-language edit to retrieve images that apply the requested change while preserving other relevant visual content.
sentences.zh: 组合图像检索使用一张参考图像加上一个自然语言编辑，来检索在保留其他相关视觉内容的同时应用所请求变化的图像。

sentences.en: Classic fusion pipelines typically rely on supervised triplets and can lose fine-grained cues, while recent zero-shot approaches often caption the reference image and merge the caption with the edit, which may miss implicit user intent and return repetitive results.
sentences.zh: 经典的融合流程通常依赖有监督的三元组，可能丢失细粒度线索；而近期的零样本方法往往对参考图像进行描述并将描述与编辑合并，这可能遗漏用户的隐式意图并返回重复的结果。

sentences.en: We present Pix2Key, which represents both queries and candidates as open-vocabulary visual dictionaries, enabling intent-aware constraint matching and diversity-aware reranking in a unified embedding space.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了Pix2Key，它将查询与候选都表示为开放词汇的视觉字典，从而在统一嵌入空间中实现意图感知的约束匹配与多样性感知的重排序。

sentences.en: A self-supervised pretraining component, V-Dict-AE, further improves the dictionary representation using only images, strengthening fine-grained attribute understanding without CIR-specific supervision.
sentences.zh: 一个自监督预训练组件V-Dict-AE进一步仅使用图像改进字典表示，在无CIR特定监督的情况下强化细粒度属性理解。

sentences.en: On the extended DeepFashion-MM benchmark, Pix2Key improves Recall@10 up to 3.2 points, and adding V-Dict-AE yields an additional 2.3-point gain while improving intent consistency and maintaining high list diversity.
sentences.zh: 在扩展的DeepFashion-MM基准上，Pix2Key将Recall@10提升了最多3.2个百分点，而加入V-Dict-AE又能带来额外2.3个百分点的增益，同时提升了意图一致性并保持了高列表多样性。

title_en: PixCLIP: Towards Fine-grained Vision-Language Understanding via Any-granularity Pixel-Text Alignment
title_zh: PixCLIP：通过任意粒度的像素-文本对齐实现细粒度视觉-语言理解

sentences.en: While CLIP has achieved strong performance across vision–language tasks, fine-grained image–text alignment remains challenging.
sentences.zh: 虽然CLIP在跨视觉-语言任务上取得了强劲性能，但细粒度的图像-文本对齐仍具挑战性。

sentences.en: Recent efforts improve textual granularity by leveraging long, detailed descriptions and replacing CLIP’s text encoder with LLM, but often overlook the visual-side bottleneck: achieving finer alignment requires region- and pixel-level visual grounding.
sentences.zh: 近期工作通过利用长而详细的描述并用LLM替换CLIP的文本编码器来改进文本粒度，但往往忽视了视觉侧的瓶颈：实现更细的对齐需要区域级与像素级的视觉定位。

sentences.en: To address it, we propose PixCLIP, a framework that jointly enhances both sides by accommodating visual prompt regions and long-form text within a unified training objective.
sentences.zh: 为解决这一问题，我们提出了PixCLIP，一个在统一训练目标内兼顾视觉提示区域与长文文本、从而协同增强两侧的框架。

sentences.en: Firstly, to support training at this granularity, we develop an automated annotation pipeline that produces long-form descriptions with pixel-level localization, and use it to construct LongGRIT, a large-scale dataset with 1.5M samples.
sentences.zh: 首先，为支持该粒度的训练，我们开发了自动化标注流程，生成带像素级定位的长文描述，并用它构建了LongGRIT，一个包含150万样本的大规模数据集。

sentences.en: Furthermore, we introduce a three-branch pixel–text alignment framework that aligns image regions with corresponding textual descriptions across multiple granularities.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们引入了一个三分支像素-文本对齐框架，跨多种粒度将图像区域与相应的文本描述对齐。

sentences.en: Experiments show that PixCLIP achieves state-of-the-art performance on pixel- and region-level alignment tasks while preserving strong results on standard global image–text retrieval benchmarks, even with arbitrarily shaped region prompts and long texts.
sentences.zh: 实验表明，即使面对任意形状的区域提示与长文本，PixCLIP在像素级与区域级对齐任务上也实现了最先进的性能，同时在标准全局图像-文本检索基准上保持强劲结果。

sentences.en: Our code is available at https://github.com/StuHude/PixCLIP.
sentences.zh: 我们的代码可在 https://github.com/StuHude/PixCLIP 获取。

title_en: PLaID++: A Preference Aligned Language Model for Targeted Inorganic Materials Design
title_zh: PLaID++：一个面向目标性无机材料设计的偏好对齐语言模型

sentences.en: Reinforcement Learning from Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has emerged as a promising approach to improve correctness in LLMs, however, in many scientific problems, the objective is not necessarily to produce *the* correct answer, but instead to produce a diverse array of candidates which satisfy a set of constraints.
sentences.zh: 基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）已成为提高LLM正确性的有前景方法，然而在许多科学问题中，目标未必是产生*那个*正确答案，而是产生满足一组约束的多样化候选。

sentences.en: We study this challenge in the context of materials generation.
sentences.zh: 我们在材料生成的背景下研究这一挑战。

sentences.en: To this end, we introduce PLaID++, an LLM post-trained for stable and property-guided crystal generation.
sentences.zh: 为此，我们引入了PLaID++，一个为稳定且属性引导的晶体生成而进行后训练的LLM。

sentences.en: We find that applying naive preference optimization to a coordinate-based crystal representation leads to mode collapse.
sentences.zh: 我们发现，将朴素偏好优化应用于基于坐标的晶体表示会导致模式坍缩。

sentences.en: Hence, we introduce a compact, symmetry-informed Wyckoff text representation which improves computational efficiency and encourages generalization from physical priors.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们引入一种紧凑、基于对称信息的Wyckoff文本表示，它提高了计算效率，并鼓励从物理先验中泛化。

sentences.en: By encoding symmetry constraints directly into text and guiding model outputs towards desirable chemical space, PLaID++ generates structures that are thermodynamically stable, unique, and novel at a $>$50\% greater rate than prior methods.
sentences.zh: 通过将对称约束直接编码进文本并将模型输出引导到理想的化学空间，PLaID++生成的结构在热力学稳定性、独特性与新颖性方面比先前方法高出$>$50\%以上。

sentences.en: We further demonstrate that unified training across conditional and unconditional tasks are mutually beneficial in data-sparse regimes.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步证明，在数据稀疏的环境中，条件与非条件任务的联合训练是互利的。

sentences.en: Our work demonstrates the potential of adapting post-training techniques from natural language processing to materials design, paving the way for targeted and efficient discovery of novel materials.
sentences.zh: 我们的工作展示了将自然语言处理的后训练技术迁移到材料设计的潜力，为靶向且高效地发现新材料铺平了道路。

title_en: Plain Transformers are Surprisingly Powerful Link Predictors
title_zh: 朴素Transformer是出人意料的强大链接预测器

sentences.en: Link prediction is a core challenge in graph machine learning, demanding models that capture rich and complex topological dependencies.
sentences.zh: 链接预测是图机器学习中的核心挑战，需要能够捕捉丰富而复杂拓扑依赖的模型。

sentences.en: While Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) are the standard solution, state-of-the-art pipelines often rely on explicit structural heuristics or memory-intensive node embeddings—approaches that struggle to generalize or scale to massive graphs.
sentences.zh: 虽然图神经网络（GNN）是标准解法，但最先进的流程往往依赖显式结构启发式或占用内存的节点嵌入——这些方法难以泛化或扩展到大规模图。

sentences.en: Emerging Graph Transformers (GTs) offer a potential alternative but often incur significant overhead due to complex structural encodings, hindering their applications to large-scale link prediction.
sentences.zh: 新兴的图Transformer（GT）提供了潜在替代方案，但常因复杂的结构编码而带来显著开销，阻碍它们应用于大规模链接预测。

sentences.en: We challenge these sophisticated paradigms with PENCIL, an encoder-only plain Transformer that replaces hand-crafted priors with attention over sampled local subgraphs, retaining the scalability and hardware efficiency of standard Transformers.
sentences.zh: 我们用PENCIL挑战这些复杂范式，它是一个仅编码器的朴素Transformer，用对采样局部子图的注意力替代手工先验，同时保留标准Transformer的可扩展性与硬件效率。

sentences.en: Through experimental and theoretical analysis, we show that PENCIL extracts richer structural signals than GNNs, implicitly generalizing a broad class of heuristics and subgraph-based expressivity.
sentences.zh: 通过实验与理论分析，我们表明PENCIL能提取比GNN更丰富的结构信号，隐式泛化了一大类启发式方法与基于子图的表达力。

sentences.en: Empirically, PENCIL outperforms heuristic-informed GNNs and is far more parameter-efficient than ID-embedding–based alternatives, while remaining competitive across diverse benchmarks—even without node features.
sentences.zh: 实证上，PENCIL优于启发式信息化的GNN，且远比基于ID嵌入的替代方案参数高效，同时在多个基准上保持竞争力——即使没有节点特征也是如此。

sentences.en: Our results challenge the prevailing reliance on complex engineering techniques, demonstrating that simple design choices are potentially sufficient to achieve the same capabilities.
sentences.zh: 我们的结果挑战了对复杂工程技术的主流依赖，表明简单的设计选择可能足以实现同等能力。

sentences.en: Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/quang-truong/pencil.
sentences.zh: 我们的代码已在 https://github.com/quang-truong/pencil 公开提供。

title_en: Plan for Speed: Dilated Scheduling for Masked Diffusion Language Models
title_zh: 为速度而规划：掩码扩散语言模型的膨胀调度

sentences.en: Masked diffusion language models (MDLMs) promise fast, non-autoregressive text generation, yet existing samplers, which pick tokens to unmask based on model confidence, ignore interactions when unmasking multiple positions in parallel and effectively reduce to slow, autoregressive behavior.
sentences.zh: 掩码扩散语言模型（MDLM）有望实现快速、非自回归的文本生成，然而现有采样器根据模型置信度选择要解除掩码的词元，在并行解除多个位置的掩码时忽略了交互，实际上退化为缓慢的自回归行为。

sentences.en: We propose the Dilated Unmasking Scheduler (DUS), an inference-only, planner-model-free method that partitions sequence positions into non-adjacent dilated groups and unmasks them in parallel so as to minimize an upper bound on joint entropy gain at each denoising step.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了膨胀解除掩码调度器（DUS），一种仅推理、无需规划器模型的方法，它将序列位置划分为不相邻的膨胀组并并行解除掩码，从而在每一步去噪中最小化联合熵增益的上界。

sentences.en: By explicitly trading off the number of network calls against generation quality, DUS recovers most of the performance lost under traditional parallel unmasking strategies.
sentences.zh: 通过显式地在网络调用次数与生成质量之间进行权衡，DUS恢复了传统并行解除掩码策略下损失的大部分性能。

sentences.en: Across math (GSM8K, MATH500), code (HumanEval, MBPP), general-knowledge (BBH, MMLU-Pro), and instruction following (IFEval) benchmarks, DUS outperforms confidence-based planners and turns the diffusion-specific quality-speed trade-off into a deterministic, predictable speedup set by the block size $B$, yielding up to $5.8\times$ wall-clock speedup over token-by-token MDLM decoding without modifying the underlying denoiser.
sentences.zh: 在数学（GSM8K、MATH500）、代码（HumanEval、MBPP）、通用知识（BBH、MMLU-Pro）与指令遵循（IFEval）基准上，DUS优于基于置信度的规划器，并将扩散特有的质量-速度权衡转化为由块大小$B$设定的确定性、可预测的加速，在不修改底层去噪器的前提下，相比逐词元MDLM解码实现最高$5.8\times$的墙钟加速。

sentences.en: Applied as a drop-in post-filter, dilated spacing also improves adaptive samplers.
sentences.zh: 作为即插即用的后置滤波器，膨胀稀疏化还改进了自适应采样器。

sentences.en: Code is available at https://github.com/omerlux/DUS.
sentences.zh: 代码可在 https://github.com/omerlux/DUS 获取。

title_en: Plan in Sandbox, Navigate in Open Worlds: Learning Physics-Grounded Abstracted Experience for Embodied Navigation
title_zh: 在沙盒中规划，在开放世界中导航：为具身导航学习物理接地的抽象经验

sentences.en: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have demonstrated exceptional general reasoning capabilities.
sentences.zh: 视觉-语言模型（VLM）展现出卓越的通用推理能力。

sentences.en: However, their performance in embodied navigation remains hindered by a scarcity of aligned open-world vision and robot control data.
sentences.zh: 然而，它们在具身导航中的性能仍受制于对齐的开放世界视觉与机器人控制数据的稀缺。

sentences.en: Despite simulators providing a cost-effective alternative for data collection, the inherent reliance on photorealistic simulations often limits the transferability of learned policies.
sentences.zh: 尽管模拟器为数据收集提供了经济高效的替代方案，但对照片级仿真模拟的内在依赖往往限制了所学策略的可迁移性。

sentences.en: To this end, we propose ***S**andbox-**A**bstracted **G**rounded **E**xperience* (***SAGE***), a framework that enables agents to learn within a physics-grounded semantic abstraction rather than a photorealistic simulation, mimicking the human capacity for mental simulation where plans are rehearsed in simplified physics abstractions before execution.
sentences.zh: 为此，我们提出了***S**andbox-**A**bstracted **G**rounded **E**xperience*（***SAGE***），一个使智能体能够在物理接地的语义抽象中而非照片级仿真模拟中学习的框架，这模仿了人类进行心理模拟的能力，即在执行前在简化的物理抽象中预演计划。

sentences.en: *SAGE* operates via three synergistic phases: (1) *Genesis*: constructing diverse, physics-constrained semantic environments to bootstrap experience;
sentences.zh: *SAGE*通过三个协同阶段运作：（1）*创世纪（Genesis）*：构建多样、受物理约束的语义环境以引导经验；

sentences.en: (2) *Evolution*: distilling experiences through Reinforcement Learning (RL), utilizing a novel asymmetric adaptive clipping mechanism to stabilize updates;
sentences.zh: （2）*演化（Evolution）*：通过强化学习（RL）蒸馏经验，利用一种新颖的非对称自适应剪裁机制稳定更新；

sentences.en: (3) *Navigation*: bridging the abstract policy to open-world control.
sentences.zh: （3）*导航（Navigation）*：将抽象策略桥接到开放世界控制。

sentences.en: We demonstrate that *SAGE* significantly improves planner-assisted embodied navigation, achieving a 53.21% LLM-Match Success Rate on A-EQA (+9.7% over baseline), while showing encouraging transfer to physical indoor robot deployment.
sentences.zh: 我们表明，*SAGE*显著改善了规划器辅助的具身导航，在A-EQA上实现了53.21%的LLM匹配成功率（较基线+9.7%），并在实体室内机器人部署中展现出令人鼓舞的迁移效果。

title_en: Plan Then Action: High-Level Planning Guidance Reinforcement Learning  for LLM Reasoning
title_zh: 先规划后行动：用于LLM推理的高层规划引导强化学习

sentences.en: Large language models (LLMs) demonstrate strong reasoning abilities via Chain-of-Thought (CoT), but their token-level generation encourages local decisions and lacks global planning, often leading to redundant or inaccurate reasoning.
sentences.zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）通过思维链（CoT）展现出强大的推理能力，但其词元级生成鼓励局部决策而缺乏全局规划，往往导致冗余或不准确的推理。

sentences.en: Existing methods, such as tree-based search and reinforcement learning (RL), attempt to address this issue but incur high computational costs and still struggle to produce reliable reasoning trajectories.
sentences.zh: 现有的方法，诸如基于树搜索和强化学习（RL），试图解决这一问题，但计算成本高，且仍难以产生可靠的推理轨迹。

sentences.en: To address these challenges, we propose Plan-Then-Action Enhanced Reasoning with Group Relative Policy Optimization (PTA-GRPO), a two-stage framework designed to jointly improve high-level planning and fine-grained CoT reasoning.
sentences.zh: 为应对这些挑战，我们提出了先规划后行动增强推理与群体相对策略优化（PTA-GRPO），一个旨在联合改进高层规划与细粒度CoT推理的两阶段框架。

sentences.en: Specifically, in the first stage, a given LLM is responsible for summarizing CoT reasoning into compact high-level guidance, which is then leveraged for supervised fine-tuning.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，在第一阶段，给定的LLM负责将CoT推理总结为紧凑的高层指导，随后该指导被用于监督微调。

sentences.en: Then, we introduce a guidance-aware reinforcement learning method that jointly optimizes the final output and the quality of guidance, enhancing reasoning effectiveness.
sentences.zh: 然后，我们引入一种指导感知的强化学习方法，它联合优化最终输出与指导质量，增强推理有效性。

sentences.en: We evaluate PTA-GRPO on ten reasoning benchmarks across mathematics and natural sciences, using five diverse base models spanning multiple data modalities.
sentences.zh: 我们在跨数学与自然科学的十个推理基准上评估PTA-GRPO，使用跨越多种数据模态的五个不同的基础模型。

sentences.en: The results show that PTA-GRPO consistently delivers stable and significant improvements across models and tasks, demonstrating strong effectiveness and generalization.
sentences.zh: 结果表明，PTA-GRPO在多个模型与任务上持续带来稳定而显著的改进，展现了强大的有效性与泛化能力。

title_en: Plan, Decouple, Assimilate: Physics-Aware Object Insertion in Remote Sensing Imagery
title_zh: 规划、解耦、同化：遥感影像中的物理感知物体插入

sentences.en: Object insertion has emerged as a promising augmentation paradigm for the label scarcity and long-tailed distributions in remote sensing, generating training samples by synthesizing target instances onto real backgrounds.
sentences.zh: 物体插入已成为应对遥感中标签稀缺与长尾分布的有前景增强范式，它将目标实例合成到真实背景之上来生成训练样本。

sentences.en: However, existing methods suffer from three critical issues: (i) semantic placement inconsistency, (ii) radiometric inconsistency with illumination and atmospheric conditions, and (iii) textural discontinuity.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有方法存在三个关键问题：（i）语义放置不一致，（ii）与光照及大气条件相关的辐射不一致，以及（iii）纹理不连续。

sentences.en: To address these, we propose a physics-aware method, "Plan, Decouple, Assimilate" (PDA), for generating high-fidelity training samples.
sentences.zh: 为解决这些问题，我们提出了一种物理感知方法规划、解耦、同化（PDA），用于生成高保真训练样本。

sentences.en: In the planning stage, the Planning (P) module automatically generates geometrically valid bounding boxes.
sentences.zh: 在规划阶段，规划（P）模块自动生成几何有效的边界框。

sentences.en: In the generation stage, a dual-module design synthesizes the target instance: the Decoupling (D) module employs Asymmetric Spectral Adaptation to disentangle structural identity from environmental illumination, while the Assimilation (A) module uses Neighborhood-Aware Texture Assimilation to harmonize the local manifold.
sentences.zh: 在生成阶段，一个双模块设计合成目标实例：解耦（D）模块采用非对称光谱适配来解耦结构身份与环境光照，而同化（A）模块使用邻域感知的纹理同化来协调局部流形。

sentences.en: By integrating these modules, PDA enforces multi-level consistency from global geometry to local micro-textures.
sentences.zh: 通过整合这些模块，PDA实现了从全局几何到局部微纹理的多层次一致性。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments verify that PDA outperforms state-of-the-art methods in generative quality, reducing whole-image FID by 15.7% over the strongest baseline, and substantially improves downstream detection, boosting average mAP50 by +17.07 points over the real data.
sentences.zh: 大量实验证实，PDA在生成质量上优于最先进的方法，使整图FID比最强基线降低15.7%，并大幅改善下游检测，将平均mAP50比真实数据提升+17.07个百分点。

title_en: Planar Symmetric Pattern Generation
title_zh: 平面对称模式生成

sentences.en: Generating objects with specific symmetries is essential in various real-world scenarios.
sentences.zh: 在多种真实场景中，生成具有特定对称性的物体是必需的。

sentences.en: However, adapting existing 2D continuous representations to enforce planar group symmetry remains a challenge, as the transformation of non-reflective group elements may disrupt continuity.
sentences.zh: 然而，适配现有的2D连续表示来施加平面群对称性仍是一个挑战，因为非反射群元素的变换可能破坏连续性。

sentences.en: To overcome this limitation, we propose a symmetrization framework for arbitrary planar groups.
sentences.zh: 为克服这一局限，我们提出了一个适用于任意平面群的对称化框架。

sentences.en: Our method transforms any 2D continuous representation into a symmetric one while preserving continuity.
sentences.zh: 我们的方法在保持连续性的同时，将任意2D连续表示变换为对称表示。

sentences.en: We provide the mathematical formulation of this representation, demonstrate its approximation capability for symmetric functions, and detail the construction methodology.
sentences.zh: 我们给出了该表示的数学表述，展示了它对对称函数的逼近能力，并详细说明了构建方法。

sentences.en: We validate our approach through three visual design tasks (pattern design, paper-cutting design and stylized topology design) and one material design task.
sentences.zh: 我们通过三个视觉设计任务（图案设计、剪纸设计与风格化拓扑设计）和一项材料设计任务验证了我们的方法。

sentences.en: Experiments confirm that our representation enables effective symmetry control and demonstrate its broader applicability.
sentences.zh: 实验证实，我们的表示能够实现有效的对称控制，并展示出其更广泛的适用性。

title_en: PLANTAIN: Plan-Answer Interleaved Reasoning
title_zh: PLANTAIN：规划-回答交错的推理

sentences.en: Reasoning models often spend a lot of time thinking before they generate a visible response.
sentences.zh: 推理模型在生成可见响应之前往往花费大量时间思考。

sentences.en: This creates a frustrating, but unfortunately common, experience: the user's time is wasted while the model reasons from a false premise that could have easily been corrected.
sentences.zh: 这造成了一种令人沮丧但不幸常见的体验：当模型基于一个本可轻易纠正的错误前提进行推理时，用户的时间被浪费。

sentences.en: In contrast, human speakers perform lightweight, incremental check-ins to ensure that conversational participants stay on common ground.
sentences.zh: 相比之下，人类说话者会进行轻量、增量的确认，以确保对话参与者保持共同理解。

sentences.en: With this motivation, we propose \textit{interleaved reasoning} (IR), in which the model alternates between thinking and surfacing intermediate responses, as an alternative to the standard ``think-then-answer'' approach.
sentences.zh: 基于这一动机，我们提出了\textit{交错推理}（IR），模型在思考与呈现中间响应之间交替进行，作为标准的先想好再回答（think-then-answer）方法的替代方案。

sentences.en: By providing useful information to the user earlier, IR reduces perceived latency, the time a user waits for an initial output, without compromising the quality of the final response.
sentences.zh: 通过更早地向用户提供有用信息，IR降低了感知延迟，即用户等待初始输出的时间，同时不损害最终响应的质量。

sentences.en: We focus on a specialization of interleaved reasoning, \method (\textul{Plan}-\textul{T}hought-\textul{A}nswer \textul{In}terleaving),  where the first intermediate response is an explicit, step-by-step \textit{plan} for executing the task.
sentences.zh: 我们聚焦于交错推理的一个特化，\method（\textul{Plan}-\textul{T}hought-\textul{A}nswer \textul{In}terleaving），其中第一个中间响应是执行任务的显式、逐步的\textit{规划}。

sentences.en: This plan-first strategy allows for user intervention and early feedback for subsequent reasoning steps.
sentences.zh: 这种先规划的策略允许用户干预，并为后续推理步骤提供早期反馈。

sentences.en: \method\ yields an $\sim$6\% improvement in pass@1 across several challenging math reasoning and coding benchmarks, while reducing time-to-first-response by over 60\% relative to think-then-answer baselines.
sentences.zh: \method\ 在多个具有挑战性的数学推理与编码基准上实现了约$\sim$6\%的pass@1提升，同时相比先想好再回答基线，将首次响应时间缩短了60\%以上。

title_en: PLASH: Provably Linear-Time Attention with Selective Higher-Order Feature Sketching
title_zh: PLASH：通过选择性高阶特征素描实现可证明的线性时间注意力

sentences.en: Standard softmax attention scales quadratically with sequence length, which makes long-context training and inference expensive.
sentences.zh: 标准softmax注意力随序列长度二次扩展，这使得长上下文训练与推理代价高昂。

sentences.en: We introduce PLASH, an attention block whose cost grows linearly in the number of keys.
sentences.zh: 我们引入了PLASH，一个计算成本随键数量线性增长的注意力模块。

sentences.en: PLASH compresses the original keys and values into $M$ learned prototypes, where $M\in\mathbb{Z}_{>0}$ is much smaller than the number of keys.
sentences.zh: PLASH将原始键与值压缩为$M$个学习到的原型，其中$M\in\mathbb{Z}_{>0}$远小于键的数量。

sentences.en: The compressed prototypes are then enriched with randomized polynomial features that recover inter-token information lost to compression.
sentences.zh: 随后，这些压缩原型通过随机多项式特征加以丰富，以恢复压缩过程中丢失的词元间信息。

sentences.en: The output is computed by exact scaled dot-product softmax attention from each query to the enriched prototypes, so PLASH preserves the standard attention interface.
sentences.zh: 输出由每个查询到丰富原型的精确缩放点积softmax注意力计算得出，因此PLASH保留了标准注意力接口。

sentences.en: The construction applies to self- and cross-attention.
sentences.zh: 该构造适用于自注意与交叉注意力。

sentences.en: We prove sketch-error bounds for the enrichment step, a per-input certificate that upper-bounds the deviation from standard softmax attention on each forward pass, and a runtime bound linear in the number of queries and keys.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了丰富步骤的素描误差界、一个对每个输入成立的证书（它在每次前向传播时给出来自标准softmax注意力的偏差上界），以及一个随查询与键数量线性增长的运行时界。

sentences.en: Experiments on long-context language modeling (Qwen3-4B on PG-19) and time-series forecasting (ETT, ECL, Weather) show competitive accuracy and favorable scaling against efficient-attention baselines.
sentences.zh: 在长上下文语言建模（PG-19上的Qwen3-4B）与时间序列预测（ETT、ECL、Weather）上的实验表明，与高效注意力基线相比，具有竞争力的精度与良好的可扩展性。

title_en: Plasticity Activation via Polar Operator: A Plug-in Method for Balancing Stability and Plasticity
title_zh: 通过极算子激活可塑性：一种平衡稳定性与可塑性的即插即用方法

sentences.en: Continual learning (CL) seeks models that acquire new knowledge while avoiding catastrophic forgetting.
sentences.zh: 持续学习（CL）寻求在获取新知识的同时避免灾难性遗忘的模型。

sentences.en: However, many methods that mitigate forgetting constrain parameter updates and thereby reduce model plasticity.
sentences.zh: 然而，许多缓解遗忘的方法约束参数更新，从而降低了模型的可塑性。

sentences.en: We revisit the singular value spectrum of gradients in representative CL methods and show that they commonly exhibit singular value collapse, where only a small subset of gradient directions drive parameter updates.
sentences.zh: 我们重新审视了代表性CL方法中梯度的奇异值谱，表明它们通常表现出奇异值坍缩，即只有一小部分梯度方向驱动参数更新。

sentences.en: Motivated by this observation, we propose **P**lasticity **A**ctivation via **P**olar **O**perator (PAPO), a plug-in that preserves the dominant directions that mitigate forgetting while activating previously suppressed directions to enhance plasticity.
sentences.zh: 基于这一观察，我们提出了通过极算子激活可塑性（PAPO），一种即插即用方法，它保留缓解遗忘的主导方向，同时激活先前被抑制的方向以增强可塑性。

sentences.en: Concretely, PAPO modifies the gradient $\mathbf{G}$ as $\mathbf{G}\leftarrow \mathbf{G}+\lambda \cdot \operatorname{polar}(\mathbf{G})$, which uniformly increases near-zero singular values without changing the singular vectors.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，PAPO将梯度$\mathbf{G}$修改为$\mathbf{G}\leftarrow \mathbf{G}+\lambda \cdot \operatorname{polar}(\mathbf{G})$，在不改变奇异向量的情况下均匀增大接近零的奇异值。

sentences.en: To avoid the cost of explicit singular value decomposition, we approximate the polar factor using the iteration-dependent Polar Express scheme, which relies only on matrix multiplications and additions.
sentences.zh: 为避免显式奇异值分解的成本，我们使用依赖迭代的Polar Express方案来近似极因子，该方案仅依赖矩阵乘法与加法。

sentences.en: In our empirical evaluation on both vision and language benchmarks, incorporating PAPO yields consistent improvements.
sentences.zh: 在我们对视觉与语言基准的实证评估中，引入PAPO带来了一致的改进。

sentences.en: In particular, on MiniImageNet, integrating PAPO into ER, MAS, GPM and TRGP produces substantial accuracy gains of $9.01\%$, $4.76\%$, $8.90\%$ and $9.19\%$, respectively.
sentences.zh: 特别是，在MiniImageNet上，将PAPO整合进ER、MAS、GPM与TRGP分别带来了$9.01\%$、$4.76\%$、$8.90\%$与$9.19\%$的可观精度增益。

title_en: PLATE: Plasticity-Tunable Efficient Adapters for Geometry-Aware Continual Learning
title_zh: PLATE：面向几何感知持续学习的可调可塑性高效适配器

sentences.en: We develop a continual learning method for pretrained models that \emph{requires no access to old-task data}, addressing a practical barrier in foundation model adaptation where pretraining distributions are often unavailable.
sentences.zh: 我们为预训练模型开发了一种\emph{无需访问旧任务数据}的持续学习方法，解决了基础模型适配中的一个实际障碍，即预训练分布往往不可用。

sentences.en: Our key observation is that pretrained networks exhibit substantial \emph{geometric redundancy}, and that this redundancy can be exploited in two complementary ways.
sentences.zh: 我们的关键观察是预训练网络具有显著的\emph{几何冗余}，而这种冗余可以通过两种互补的方式加以利用。

sentences.en: First, redundant neurons provide a proxy for dominant pretraining-era feature directions, enabling the construction of approximately protected update subspaces directly from pretrained weights.
sentences.zh: 首先，冗余神经元为占主导的预训练时代特征方向提供了一个代理，使我们能够直接从预训练权重构建近似受保护的更新子空间。

sentences.en: Second, redundancy offers a natural bias for \emph{where} to place plasticity: by restricting updates to a subset of redundant neurons and constraining the remaining degrees of freedom, we obtain update families with reduced functional drift on the old-data distribution and improved worst-case retention guarantees.
sentences.zh: 其次，冗余为可塑性应置于*何处*提供了自然的偏置：通过将更新限制到冗余神经元的子集并约束其余自由度，我们获得在旧数据分布上功能漂移减少、最差情况保留保证得以改善的更新族。

sentences.en: These insights lead to \textsc{PLATE} (\textbf{Pla}sticity-\textbf{T}unable \textbf{E}fficient Adapters), a continual learning method requiring no past-task data that provides explicit control over the plasticity-retention trade-off.
sentences.zh: 这些洞见引出了\textsc{PLATE}（\textbf{Pla}sticity-\textbf{T}unable \textbf{E}fficient Adapters，即可调可塑性的高效适配器），一种无需过去任务数据的持续学习方法，提供对可塑性-保留权衡的显式控制。

sentences.en: PLATE parameterizes each layer with a structured low-rank update $\Delta W = B A Q^\top$, where $B$ and $Q$ are computed once from pretrained weights and kept frozen, and only $A$ is trained on the new task.
sentences.zh: PLATE用结构化低秩更新$\Delta W = B A Q^\top$参数化每一层，其中$B$与$Q$由预训练权重一次性计算并保持冻结，仅有$A$在新任务上训练。

sentences.en: Code is available at https://github.com/SalesforceAIResearch/PLATE.
sentences.zh: 代码可在 https://github.com/SalesforceAIResearch/PLATE 获取。

title_en: Platonic Transformers: A Solid Choice For Equivariance
title_zh: 柏拉图式Transformer：等变性的可靠选择

sentences.en: While widespread, Transformers lack inductive biases for geometric symmetries common in science and computer vision.
sentences.zh: 虽然Transformer被广泛使用，但它们缺乏科学与计算机视觉中常见几何对称性的归纳偏置。

sentences.en: Existing equivariant methods often sacrifice the efficiency and flexibility that make Transformers so effective through complex, computationally intensive designs.
sentences.zh: 现有的等变方法往往通过复杂、计算密集的设计，牺牲了使Transformer如此有效的效率与灵活性。

sentences.en: We introduce the Platonic Transformer to resolve this trade-off.
sentences.zh: 我们引入柏拉图式Transformer来解决这一权衡。

sentences.en: By defining attention relative to reference frames from the Platonic solid symmetry groups, our method induces a principled weight-sharing scheme.
sentences.zh: 通过相对于柏拉图立体对称群的参考系来定义注意力，我们的方法引入了一个原则性的权重共享方案。

sentences.en: This enables combined equivariance to continuous translations and Platonic symmetries, while preserving the exact architecture and computational cost of a standard Transformer.
sentences.zh: 这使得在对连续平移和柏拉图对称性方面实现组合等变性的同时，保留了标准Transformer的精确架构与计算成本。

sentences.en: Furthermore, we show that this attention is formally equivalent to a dynamic group convolution, which reveals that the model learns adaptive geometric filters and enables a *highly scalable, linear-time convolutional variant*.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们表明这种注意力在形式上等价于动态群卷积，这揭示了模型学习自适应几何滤波器，并能够实现*高度可扩展的线性时间卷积变体*。

sentences.en: Across diverse benchmarks in computer vision (CIFAR-10), 3D point clouds (ScanObjectNN), and molecular dynamics, property prediction and generation (OMol25, ProteinMD, QM9), the Platonic Transformer achieves competitive performance by leveraging these geometric constraints at no additional cost.
sentences.zh: 在计算机视觉（CIFAR-10）、3D点云（ScanObjectNN）以及分子动力学、性质预测与生成（OMol25、ProteinMD、QM9）等多个基准上，柏拉图式Transformer以零额外成本利用这些几何约束取得了有竞争力的性能。

title_en: PLoRA: Efficient Concurrent LoRA Training for Large Language Models
title_zh: PLoRA：大型语言模型的高效并发LoRA训练

sentences.en: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) has gained popularity as a fine-tuning approach for Large Language Models (LLMs) due to its low resource requirements and good performance.
sentences.zh: 低秩适配（LoRA）因其低资源需求与良好性能而成为大型语言模型（LLM）微调方法中的热门选择。

sentences.en: While numerous studies have investigated improving LoRA serving efficiency by serving multiple LoRAs concurrently, existing methods assume that a wide range of LoRA adapters are available for serving.
sentences.zh: 虽然大量研究通过并发服务多个LoRA来改进LoRA服务效率，但现有方法假设有大量的LoRA适配器可供服务。

sentences.en: In our work, we conduct extensive empirical studies to show that current LoRA training paradigms do not efficiently utilize hardware resources and incur high overhead to obtain a performant LoRA adapter.
sentences.zh: 在我们的工作中，我们进行了广泛的实证研究，表明当前的LoRA训练范式并未高效利用硬件资源，并且获得一个性能良好的LoRA适配器开销很高。

sentences.en: Leveraging these insights, we propose PLoRA, which automatically orchestrates concurrent LoRA fine-tuning jobs under given hardware and model constraints and develops performant kernels to improve training efficiency.
sentences.zh: 利用这些洞见，我们提出了PLoRA，它在给定的硬件与模型约束下自动编排并发的LoRA微调任务，并开发高性能核以改进训练效率。

sentences.en: Across a range of LLMs and LoRA configurations, PLoRA improves training throughput by up to 12.8x and reduces the overall fine-tuning makespan by up to 7.52x compared to existing approaches.
sentences.zh: 在多种LLM与LoRA配置下，与现有方法相比，PLoRA将训练吞吐量提升了最高12.8倍，并将整体微调工期缩短了最高7.52倍。
